value.stringValue: {"bash_command":"git","full_command":"git add Cargo.toml Cargo.lock crates/axiathon-client/Cargo.toml crates/axiathon-client/src/ crates/axiathon-client/tests/ crates/axiathon-core/src/types.rs crates/axiathon-core/tests/core_types_integration.rs","description":"Stage implementation files"}

{"bash_command":"git","full_command":"git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
feat(cli): implement Story 6.1 CLI framework and structure

Implement the axiathon-client crate with clap 4.x derive-based CLI
framework covering all 10 acceptance criteria:

- AC-1: All command groups (query, rules, alerts, ingest, config,
  status, tenant, login, completion, init, tui)
- AC-2: Help rendering with about text for all subcommands
- AC-3: CliError with exit_code() mapping (1=error, 3=auth, 4=authz)
- AC-4: OutputFormatter trait with Table/JSON/CSV implementations
- AC-5: Global flags (--format, -v, --quiet, --server, --tenant,
  --config, --no-color) all with global=true
- AC-6: Clap derive macros only (declarative)
- AC-7: SiemClient HTTP wrapper with header injection and status mapping
- AC-8: ClientConfig TOML loading with env var overrides
- AC-9: Shell completion generation via clap_complete
- AC-10: Stub handlers with "not yet implemented (Story X.Y)" messages

Security fixes:
- TenantId now validates on deserialization via custom Deserialize impl
  (fixes CWE-20 bypass where serde_json::from_str skipped new() validation)
- TenantId error message no longer echoes input (fixes CWE-209)
- SiemClient rejects CRLF in tokens/tenant IDs (CWE-113 prevention)
- SiemClient Debug redacts bearer token
- ClientConfig validates on deserialization (Rule #8 compliance)

Test quality fixes:
- Strengthened 5 vacuous/zero-assertion tests per reviewer findings
- Fixed stub story ID assertion to require "Story" not just "."
EOF
)"","description":"Commit implementation","git_commit_id":"d7bfaf2"}
